translations.idiomatic: Now prohibitions on the embankments have lapsed, encroachments and illicit breaches abound, the lake can no longer hold water, boats cannot pass, and public and private interests alike suffer.

sentences.zh: 若夏秋霖潦，則丹陽、金壇、延陵一帶良田，亦被渰沒。

translations.literal: If in summer and autumn there are heavy rains and floods, then the good fields in the Danyang, Jintan, and Yanling stretch are also inundated.
translations.idiomatic: When summer and autumn bring torrential rains, the fertile land around Danyang, Jintan, and Yanling is flooded as well.

sentences.zh: 臣已令丹陽知縣朱穆等增置二斗門、一石鹈達，及修補堤防，盡復舊跡，庶為永久之利。」

translations.literal: Your subject has already ordered Danyang magistrate Zhu Mu and others to add two sluice-gates and one stone barrage, and to repair the dikes and banks, fully restoring the old traces, so that there may be lasting benefit."
translations.idiomatic: I have ordered Magistrate Zhu Mu of Danyang and others to install two sluice-gates and one stone barrage, repair the embankments, and restore the works to their former state for lasting benefit."

sentences.zh: 乾道七年，以臣僚言：「丹陽練湖幅員四十里，納長山諸水，漕渠資之，故古語云：'湖水寸，渠水尺。」

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Qiandao, on the words of officials: "Danyang's Lian Lake extends forty li in circumference, receives the waters of Mount Chang and the rest, and the transport canal relies on it; hence the old saying, 'An inch of lake water, a foot of canal water.'"
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Qiandao, officials reported: "Lian Lake at Danyang spans forty li around, gathering the streams of Mount Chang and elsewhere to feed the grain canal—hence the proverb, 'An inch on the lake, a foot in the channel.'"

sentences.zh: 在唐之禁甚嚴，盜決者罪比殺人。

translations.literal: Under Tang the prohibition was very strict; illicit breachers were punished on a par with murderers.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang the ban was severe: anyone who breached the lake illegally was punished as for murder.

sentences.zh: 本朝浸緩其禁以惠民，然修築嚴甚。

translations.literal: Our dynasty has gradually relaxed the prohibition to benefit the people, yet maintenance and construction remain very strict.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty has eased the prohibition over time to benefit the people, yet upkeep of the works remains rigorously enforced.

sentences.zh: 春夏多雨之際，瀦蓄盈滿，雖秋無雨，漕渠或淺，但泄湖水一寸，則為河一尺矣。

translations.literal: In spring and summer when rain is abundant, storage fills to the brim; even if autumn has no rain and the transport canal is shallow, releasing one inch of lake water makes the river one foot.
translations.idiomatic: Through the rainy spring and summer the lake fills; even in a rainless autumn, when the canal runs low, releasing an inch of lake water raises the channel by a foot.

sentences.zh: 兵變以後，多廢不治，堤岸圮闕，不能貯水；

translations.literal: After the military upheaval, much was abandoned and left unrepaired; dikes and banks collapsed and were missing, unable to store water;
translations.idiomatic: After the military upheavals much was left unrepaired; the embankments crumbled and the lake could no longer hold water;

sentences.zh: 強家因而專利，耕以為田，遂致淤澱。

translations.literal: powerful families thereby monopolized profit, plowing it as fields, and thus caused silt and sediment.
translations.idiomatic: powerful families seized the advantage, farming the bed for themselves, until silt choked the lake.

sentences.zh: 歲月既久，其害滋廣。

translations.literal: As years lengthened, the harm grew ever wider.
translations.idiomatic: With the passing years the damage has only spread.

sentences.zh: 望責長吏浚治堙塞，立為盜決侵耕之法，著於令。

translations.literal: We hope the chief officials will be charged to dredge and clear blockages, establish laws against illicit breach and encroaching cultivation, and set them down in statutes.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that senior officials be made responsible for dredging the blockages, that laws against illegal breaches and encroaching cultivation be enacted, and that these be written into statute.

sentences.zh: 庶幾練湖漸復其舊，民田獲灌溉之利，漕渠無淺涸之患。」

translations.literal: Perhaps Lian Lake may gradually return to its former state, the people's fields obtain the benefit of irrigation, and the transport canal be free of shallow and dry affliction.
translations.idiomatic: Then Lian Lake may gradually be restored, the people's fields will receive irrigation, and the grain canal will be spared shallow and dry seasons.

sentences.zh: 詔兩浙漕臣沈度專一措置修築。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Two-Zhe transport commissioner Shen Du to take exclusive charge of arranging repairs and construction.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered the Two-Zhe transport commissioner Shen Du to take sole charge of the repairs.

sentences.zh: 慶元五年，兩浙轉運、浙西提舉言：「以鎮江府守臣重修呂城兩閘畢，再造一新閘以固堤防，庶為便利。」

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Qingyuan, the Two-Zhe transport and Zhexi intendant said: "Since the Zhenjiang prefectural chief has finished rebuilding the two gates at Lücheng, let a new gate further be built to strengthen the dikes and banks, so that there may be convenience."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Qingyuan the Two-Zhe transport office and the Zhexi intendant reported: "The Zhenjiang prefect has finished rebuilding the two gates at Lücheng; a new gate should be added to strengthen the embankments for greater benefit."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 浙西運河，自臨安府北郭務至鎮江江口閘，六百四十一里。

translations.literal: The Zhexi transport canal, from Lin'an prefecture's North Outer Station to Zhenjiang's river-mouth gate, is six hundred forty-one li.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhexi transport canal runs six hundred forty-one li from the North Outer Station of Lin'an to the river-mouth gate at Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 淳熙七年，帝因輔臣奏金使往來事，曰：「運河有淺狹處，可令守臣以漸開浚，庶不擾民。」

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Chunxi, because the chief ministers reported on Jin envoys coming and going, the emperor said: "The transport canal has shallow and narrow places; the prefectural chiefs may be ordered to dredge them gradually, so as not to disturb the people."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Chunxi, when his ministers reported on the passage of Jin envoys, the emperor said: "Where the canal is shallow or narrow, let the prefects dredge it step by step so the people are not unduly burdened."

sentences.zh: 至十一年冬，臣僚言：「運河之浚，自北關至秀州杉青，各有堰閘，自可瀦水。

translations.literal: By the winter of the eleventh year, officials said: "In dredging the transport canal, from North Pass to Xiuzhou's Shanqing, each stretch has weirs and gates and can store water on its own.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the eleventh year officials reported: "From North Pass to Shanqing in Xiuzhou the canal already has weirs and gates at each section and can hold water by itself.

sentences.zh: 惟沿河上塘有小堰數處，積久低陷，無以防遏水勢，當以時加修治。

translations.literal: Only along the river the upper embankments have several small weirs that, long accumulated, have sunk low and cannot check the water's force; they should be repaired in season.
translations.idiomatic: Only several small weirs on the upper embankments along the route have sunk over time and can no longer hold back the water; these should be repaired on schedule.

sentences.zh: 兼沿河下岸涇港極多，其水入長水塘、海鹽塘、華亭塘，由六里堰下，私港散漫，悉入江湖，以私港深、運河淺也。

translations.literal: Moreover along the river the lower banks have extremely many branch channels; their water enters Changshui Pond, Haiyan Pond, and Huating Pond, and below Liuli Weir private harbors scatter, all entering rivers and lakes, because the private harbors are deep and the transport canal shallow.
translations.idiomatic: Along the lower banks there are also countless branch channels draining into Changshui, Haiyan, and Huating ponds; below Liuli Weir private creeks spill in every direction into the rivers and lakes because the private channels run deeper than the canal.

sentences.zh: 若修固運河下岸一帶涇港，自無走泄。

translations.literal: If the branch channels along the transport canal's lower banks are repaired and secured, there will naturally be no run-off.
translations.idiomatic: If the branch channels along the canal's lower banks are repaired and secured, the water will no longer escape.

sentences.zh: 又自秀州杉青至平江府盤門，在太湖之際，與湖水相連；

translations.literal: Again from Xiuzhou's Shanqing to Pingjiang prefecture's Pan Gate, on the edge of Tai Lake, it connects with the lake water;
translations.idiomatic: From Shanqing in Xiuzhou to Pan Gate in Pingjiang the canal lies on Tai Lake and is fed by its waters;

sentences.zh: 而平江閶門至常州，有楓橋、許墅、烏角溪、新安溪、將軍堰，亦各通太湖。

translations.literal: while from Pingjiang's Chang Gate to Changzhou are Fengqiao, Xushu, Wujiao Stream, Xin'an Stream, and Jiangjun Weir, each also connecting to Tai Lake.
translations.idiomatic: and from Chang Gate in Pingjiang to Changzhou, Fengqiao, Xushu, Wujiao Stream, Xin'an Stream, and Jiangjun Weir each connect to Tai Lake as well.

sentences.zh: 如遇西風，湖水由港而入，皆不必浚。

translations.literal: If a west wind meets them, lake water enters by the harbors and dredging is altogether unnecessary.
translations.idiomatic: When the west wind blows, lake water enters through these channels and dredging is unnecessary.

sentences.zh: 惟無錫五瀉閘損壞累年，常是開堰，徹底放舟；

translations.literal: Only Wuxi's Wuxie Gate has been damaged for years; the weir is constantly opened and boats are fully released;
translations.idiomatic: Only at Wuxie's Wuxie Gate, damaged for years, the weir is kept open and boats pass through freely;

sentences.zh: 更江陰軍河港勢低，水易走泄。

translations.literal: furthermore Jiangyin commandery's river harbors lie low and water easily runs off.
translations.idiomatic: while the river channels at Jiangyin lie lower still and water escapes easily.

sentences.zh: 若從舊修築，不獨瀦水可以通舟，而無錫、晉陵間所有陽湖，亦當積水，而四傍田畝，皆無旱墻之患。

translations.literal: If repairs follow the old plan, not only will stored water allow boats to pass, but all Yang Lake between Wuxi and Jinling will also hold water, and the fields on every side will be free of drought and drying affliction.
translations.idiomatic: If the old works are restored, stored water will not only float the boats but Yang Lake between Wuxi and Jinling will fill again, and the surrounding fields will be spared drought.

sentences.zh: 獨自常州至丹陽縣，地勢高仰，雖有奔牛、呂城二閘，別無湖港瀦水；

translations.literal: Only from Changzhou to Danyang county the terrain rises high; though there are the two gates at Benniu and Lücheng, there are no other lakes or harbors to store water;
translations.idiomatic: Only from Changzhou to Danyang does the bed rise high; though Benniu and Lücheng have gates, no lake or harbor there can hold water;

sentences.zh: 自丹陽至鎮江，地形尤高，雖有練湖，緣湖水日淺，不能濟遠，雨晴未幾，便覺乾涸。

translations.literal: from Danyang to Zhenjiang the terrain is especially high; though there is Lian Lake, because the lake water daily grows shallow it cannot sustain the distance—within a few days of rain clearing it is already felt to be dry.
translations.idiomatic: from Danyang to Zhenjiang the bed is higher still; Lian Lake exists, but its water grows shallower daily and cannot carry traffic far—within days of clear weather the channel runs dry.

sentences.zh: 運河淺狹，莫此為甚，所當先浚。」

translations.literal: Nowhere is the transport canal shallower and narrower than here; it should be dredged first."
translations.idiomatic: Nowhere is the canal shallower or narrower; this stretch should be dredged first."

sentences.zh: 上以為然。

translations.literal: The emperor held this correct.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 至嘉定間，臣僚又言：「國家駐蹕錢塘，綱運糧餉，仰給諸道，所系不輕。

translations.literal: By the Jiading period, officials again said: "The state has its seat at Qiantang; convoy transport of grain provisions relies on the various circuits—the matter is not light.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiading era officials again reported: "With the court seated at Qiantang, grain convoys depend on every circuit—a matter of no small weight.

sentences.zh: 水運之程，自大江而下至鎮江則入閘，經行運河，如履平地，川、廣巨艦，直抵都城，蓋甚便也。

translations.literal: The water transport route, from the great river downstream to Zhenjiang then enters the gate, passes the transport canal as if treading level ground, and Sichuan and Guangdong great ships reach the capital directly—indeed very convenient.
translations.idiomatic: By water, cargo descends the Yangtze to Zhenjiang, enters the lock, and sails the canal as on level ground; great ships from Sichuan and Guangdong reach the capital directly—a great convenience.

sentences.zh: 比年以來，鎮江閘口河道淤塞，不復通舟，乞令漕臣同淮東總領及本府守臣，公共措置開撩。」

translations.literal: In recent years the Zhenjiang gate mouth and river channel have silted and no longer admit boats; we beg that the transport commissioner together with the Huaidong chief steward and this prefecture's chief arrange jointly to dredge and open."
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the channel at Zhenjiang's lock has silted shut; we ask that the transport commissioner, the Huaidong chief steward, and the prefect work together to dredge it open."

sentences.zh: 越州水

translations.literal: Yue prefecture waters
translations.idiomatic: The Waters of Yue Prefecture

sentences.zh: 越州水：鑒湖之廣，周回三百五十八里，環山三十六源。

translations.literal: Yue prefecture waters: Mirror Lake's extent, circumference three hundred fifty-eight li, encircled by mountains with thirty-six sources.
translations.idiomatic: The waters of Yue Prefecture: Mirror Lake spans three hundred fifty-eight li around, fed by thirty-six mountain streams.

sentences.zh: 自漢永和五年，會稽太守馬臻始築塘，溉田九千餘頃，至宋初八百年間，民受其利。

translations.literal: From Han Yonghe fifth year, Kuaiji prefect Ma Zhen first built the embankment, irrigating more than nine thousand qing of fields; down to the beginning of Song, across eight hundred years, the people received its benefit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Yonghe of Han, Prefect Ma Zhen of Kuaiji first built the embankment and irrigated more than nine thousand qing; for eight hundred years until the early Song the people prospered by it.

sentences.zh: 歲月浸遠，浚治不時，日久堙廢。

translations.literal: As years lengthened, dredging and maintenance were not timely, and over time it was blocked and abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: As the years passed dredging fell behind until the lake was choked and abandoned.

sentences.zh: 瀕湖之民，侵耕為田，熙寧中，盜為田九百餘頃。

translations.literal: People on the lake's edge encroached and plowed it as fields; in Xining, nine hundred-odd qing were illicitly made fields.
translations.idiomatic: Shore dwellers encroached and farmed the bed; in the Xining era more than nine hundred qing were illegally reclaimed.

sentences.zh: 嘗遣廬州觀察推官江衍經度其宜，凡為湖田者兩存之，立碑石為界，內者為田，外者為湖。

translations.literal: Once the Luzhou surveillance investigating censor Jiang Yan was sent to survey what was fitting; all who had made lake fields were allowed to keep half, stone steles were set as boundaries—within was field, without was lake.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Yan, investigating censor of Luzhou, was once sent to survey the lake; encroachers were allowed to keep half their fields, and stone markers were set—land within was field, land without was lake.

sentences.zh: 政和末，為郡守者務為進奉之計，遂廢湖為田，賦輸京師。

translations.literal: At the end of Zhenghe, the prefectural chief pursued plans for presenting tribute and then abandoned the lake for fields, sending tax grain to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Zhenghe the prefect, eager to curry favor with tribute, drained the lake for fields and sent the revenue to the capital.

sentences.zh: 自時奸民私占，為田益眾，湖之存者亡幾矣。

translations.literal: From that time wicked people privately occupied it; fields grew ever more numerous, and scarcely any lake remained.
translations.idiomatic: Since then unscrupulous men have seized more land for fields, and little of the lake remains.

sentences.zh: 紹興二十九年十月，帝諭樞密院事王綸曰：「往年宰執嘗欲盡幹鑒湖，雲可得十萬斛米。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the twenty-ninth year of Shaoxing, the emperor instructed Bureau of Military Affairs chief Wang Lun: "In former years the chief ministers once wished to drain Mirror Lake entirely, saying one could obtain a hundred thousand hu of rice.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the twenty-ninth year of Shaoxing the emperor told Wang Lun of the Bureau of Military Affairs: "Years ago the chief ministers wished to drain Mirror Lake entirely, promising a hundred thousand hu of rice.

sentences.zh: 朕謂若遇歲旱，無湖水引灌，則所損未必不過之。

translations.literal: I said that if a year of drought were met and there were no lake water to draw for irrigation, the loss might well not be less than the gain.
translations.idiomatic: I said that in a drought year, without lake water for irrigation, the loss might exceed the gain.

sentences.zh: 凡事須遠慮可也。」

translations.literal: In all affairs one must take far-sighted thought."
translations.idiomatic: In all things one must look to the long term."

sentences.zh: 隆興元年，紹興府守臣吳芾言：「鑒湖自江衍所立碑石之外，今為民田者，又一百六十五頃，湖盡堙廢。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longxing, Shaoxing prefectural chief Wu Bi said: "Beyond the stone markers Jiang Yan set, what is now people's fields amounts again to one hundred sixty-five qing; the lake is entirely blocked and abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Longxing Prefect Wu Bi of Shaoxing reported: "Beyond the markers Jiang Yan set, another one hundred sixty-five qing have become farmland; the lake is wholly choked.

sentences.zh: 今欲發四百九十萬工，于農隙接續開鑿。

translations.literal: Now we wish to deploy four million nine hundred thousand work-units, continuing excavation in the intervals between farming seasons.
translations.idiomatic: We propose to mobilize 4.9 million work-days and dredge in succession during the farming slack season.

sentences.zh: 又移壯城百人，以備撩灑浚治，差強幹使臣一人，以'巡轄鑒湖堤岸'為名。」

translations.literal: We will also transfer one hundred garrison troops for dredging and maintenance, and assign one capable commissioner with the title 'Patrol Superintendent of Mirror Lake Dikes and Banks.'"
translations.idiomatic: We will also assign one hundred garrison troops for dredging and appoint a capable commissioner titled 'Patrol Superintendent of Mirror Lake Embankments.'"

sentences.zh: 二年，芾又言：「修鑒湖，全藉斗門、堰閘蓄水，都泗堰閘尤為要害。

translations.literal: In the second year, Bi again said: "Repairing Mirror Lake wholly relies on sluice-gates and weir-gates to store water; the Dusi weir-gate is especially the vital point.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Bi again reported: "Restoring Mirror Lake depends entirely on sluice-gates and weirs to hold water; the Dusi gate is the critical point.

sentences.zh: 凡遇約運及監司使命舟船經過，堰兵避免車拽，必欲開閘通放，以致啟閉無時，失泄湖水。

translations.literal: Whenever scheduled transport or surveillance-commission mission boats passed, the weir soldiers, avoiding cart-hauling, invariably wished to open the gates and release them, so that opening and closing had no fixed time and lake water was lost.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever tribute convoys or official missions passed, the weir guards, eager to avoid hauling carts, would open the gates at will, so the lake water drained away without restraint.

sentences.zh: 且都泗堰因高麗使往來，宣和間方置閘，今乞廢罷。」

translations.literal: Moreover Dusi Weir was set up only in Xuanhe because of Goryeo envoys coming and going; we now beg that it be abolished."
translations.idiomatic: The Dusi gate was installed in Xuanhe only for Goryeo envoys; we ask that it now be removed."

sentences.zh: 其後芾為刑部侍郎，復奏：「自開鑒湖，溉廢田二百七十頃，復湖之舊。

translations.literal: Later, when Bi became vice minister of justice, he again memorialized: "Since opening Mirror Lake, we have irrigated two hundred seventy qing of abandoned fields and restored the lake to its former state.
translations.idiomatic: Later, as vice minister of justice, Bi memorialized again: "Since reopening Mirror Lake we have irrigated two hundred seventy qing of abandoned fields and restored the lake.

sentences.zh: 又修治斗門、堰閘十三所。

translations.literal: We have also repaired thirteen sluice-gates and weir-gates.
translations.idiomatic: We have also repaired thirteen sluice-gates and weirs.

sentences.zh: 夏秋以來，時雨雖多，亦無泛溢之患，民田九千餘頃，悉獲倍收，其為利較然可見。

translations.literal: Since summer and autumn, though seasonal rain has been abundant, there has been no flooding affliction; the people's more than nine thousand qing of fields have all obtained doubled harvests—the benefit is plainly visible by comparison.
translations.idiomatic: Through summer and autumn, though rains have been heavy, there has been no flooding; more than nine thousand qing of fields have doubled their yield—the benefit is plain.

sentences.zh: 乞將江衍原立禁牌，別定界至，則堤岸自然牢固，永無盜決之虞。」

translations.literal: We beg that Jiang Yan's original prohibition markers be used to fix boundaries anew; then the dikes and banks will naturally be secure and there will forever be no fear of illicit breach."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that Jiang Yan's prohibition markers be used to fix new boundaries; then the embankments will hold firm and illicit breaches will cease forever."

sentences.zh: 紹興初，高宗次越，以上虞縣梁湖堰東運河淺澀，令發六千五百餘工，委本縣令、佐監督浚治。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shaoxing, when Gaozong sojourned at Yue, because east of Shangyu county's Lianghu Weir the transport canal was shallow and sluggish, he ordered more than six thousand five hundred work-units deployed and entrusted the county magistrate and assistants to supervise dredging.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shaoxing, when Gaozong resided at Yue, the canal east of Lianghu Weir in Shangyu was found shallow; he ordered more than 6,500 work-days and charged the county magistrate and assistants with dredging it.

sentences.zh: 既而都省言，余姚縣境內運河淺澀，壩閘隳壞，阻滯綱運，遂命漕臣發一萬七千餘卒，自都泗堰至曹娥塔橋，開撩河身、夾塘，詔漕司給錢米。

translations.literal: Shortly after, the central secretariat reported that within Yuyao county the transport canal was shallow and sluggish and dams and gates were ruined, obstructing convoy transport; the transport commissioner was then ordered to deploy more than seventeen thousand laborers from Dusi Weir to Cao'e Pagoda Bridge to dredge the channel and flanking embankments, and the transport office was issued an edict to supply money and grain.
translations.idiomatic: The central secretariat then reported that within Yuyao the canal was shallow, the dams and gates ruined, and convoys blocked; the transport commissioner was ordered to deploy more than seventeen thousand laborers from Dusi Weir to Cao'e Pagoda Bridge to dredge the channel and banks, with funds and grain from the transport office.

sentences.zh: 蕭山縣西興鎮通江兩閘，近為江沙壅塞，舟楫不通。

translations.literal: Xiaoshan county's Xixing town has two gates connecting to the river; recently river sand has blocked them and boats cannot pass.
translations.idiomatic: At Xixing in Xiaoshan, the two river gates have lately been choked by sand and boats cannot pass.

sentences.zh: 乾道三年，守臣言：「募人自西興至大江，疏沙河二十里，並浚閘裏運河十三里，通使綱運，民旅皆利。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qiandao, the prefectural chief said: "We recruited men from Xixing to the great river to clear the sandy channel for twenty li, and also dredged the transport canal inside the gate for thirteen li, enabling convoy transport and benefiting travelers alike.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Qiandao the prefect reported: "We hired laborers to clear twenty li of sandy channel from Xixing to the Yangtze and dredged thirteen li of canal inside the gate, easing convoys and travelers alike.

sentences.zh: 復恐潮水不定，復有填淤，且通江六堰，綱運至多，宜差注指使一人，專以'開撩西興沙河'系銜，及發捍江兵士五十名，專充開撩沙浦，不得雜役，仍從本府起立營屋居之。」

translations.literal: We fear that tides are unsettled and silting may return; moreover the six weirs connecting to the river see very many convoys. One assigned controller should be dispatched with the title 'Dredging Xixing Sandy Channel' exclusively, and fifty river-defense soldiers deployed solely for dredging sandy creeks, with no mixed duties, and barracks built by this prefecture for them to dwell in."
translations.idiomatic: We fear the tides will silt it again; with six river weirs and heavy convoy traffic, one officer should be appointed solely to dredge the Xixing sandy channel, with fifty river-defense troops assigned exclusively to that work and barracks built for them by the prefecture."

sentences.zh: 常州水

translations.literal: Chang prefecture waters
translations.idiomatic: The Waters of Chang Prefecture

sentences.zh: 常州水：隆興二年，常州守臣劉唐稽言：「申、利二港，上自運河發流，經營回復，至下流析為二道，一自利港，一自申港，以達于江。

translations.literal: Chang prefecture waters: In the second year of Longxing, Changzhou prefectural chief Liu Tangji said: "The Shen and Li harbors, upstream issuing from the transport canal, have been managed and restored; at the lower reach they divide into two courses, one through Li Harbor and one through Shen Harbor, to reach the river.
translations.idiomatic: The waters of Chang Prefecture: In the second year of Longxing Prefect Liu Tangji of Changzhou reported: "The Shen and Li harbors, fed from the transport canal above, have been restored; below they split into two channels—Li Harbor and Shen Harbor—reaching the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 緣江口每日潮汐帶沙填塞，上流遊泥淤積，流泄不通；

translations.literal: Because at the river mouth daily tides carry sand to block it, upstream drifting mud and silt accumulate and the flow cannot discharge;
translations.idiomatic: At the mouth daily tides deposit sand; upstream silt accumulates and the channels no longer drain;

sentences.zh: 而申港又以江陰軍釘立標楬，拘攔稅船，每潮來，則沙泥為木標所壅，淤塞益甚。

translations.literal: Shen Harbor moreover has Jiangyin commandery drive in marker posts to detain and intercept tax boats; whenever the tide comes, sand and mud are choked by the wooden markers and silting grows worse.
translations.idiomatic: At Shen Harbor Jiangyin has driven in marker posts to intercept tax boats; each tide deposits sand against the posts and the silting grows worse.

sentences.zh: 今若相度開此二河，但下流申、利二港，並隸江陰軍，若議定深闊丈尺，各於本界開淘，庶協力皆辦。

translations.literal: If we now survey and open these two rivers, only the lower Shen and Li harbors both fall under Jiangyin commandery; if depth and breadth in zhang and chi are agreed, each may dredge within its own jurisdiction, and by combined effort all may be accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: If we survey and reopen these channels, the lower Shen and Li harbors both lie under Jiangyin; once depth and width are agreed, each jurisdiction can dredge its section and the work can be finished together.

sentences.zh: 又孟瀆一港在奔牛鎮西，唐孟簡所開，並宜興縣界沿湖舊百瀆，皆通宜興之水，藉以疏泄。

translations.literal: Moreover Mengdu Harbor lies west of Benniu town, opened by Tang's Meng Jian, together with Yixing county's old Hundred Creeks along the lake—all connect Yixing's waters and serve to drain and release.
translations.idiomatic: Mengdu Harbor west of Benniu, opened by Meng Jian of Tang, and the old Hundred Creeks along Yixing's lakeshore all connect Yixing's waters for drainage.

sentences.zh: 近歲阻于吳江石塘，流行不快，而沿湖河港所謂百瀆，存者無幾。

translations.literal: In recent years they have been blocked by Wujiang's stone embankment and flow sluggishly; of the lake-side river harbors called the Hundred Creeks, few remain.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years Wujiang's stone embankment has impeded them; of the Hundred Creeks along the lake, few survive.

sentences.zh: 今若開通，委為公私之便。」

translations.literal: If they are now opened and connected, it will truly be a convenience for public and private interests alike."
translations.idiomatic: If they are reopened now, the benefit to public and private interests alike will be real."

sentences.zh: 至乾道二年，以漕臣薑詵等請，造蔡涇閘及開申港上流橫石，次浚利港以泄水勢。

translations.literal: By the second year of Qiandao, on the request of transport commissioner Jiang Shen and others, the Caijing Gate was built and transverse stones at the upper reach of Shen Harbor were opened; next Li Harbor was dredged to release the water's force.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qiandao, at the request of Transport Commissioner Jiang Shen and others, the Caijing Gate was built, the barrier stones at the upper Shen Harbor were removed, and Li Harbor was dredged to release the water.

sentences.zh: 六年三月，又命兩浙運副劉敏士、浙西提舉芮輝於新涇塘置閘堰，以捍海潮；

translations.literal: In the third month of the sixth year, the Two-Zhe transport vice commissioner Liu Minshi and Zhexi intendant Rui Hui were again ordered to set up a gate-weir at Xinjing Pond to repel sea tides;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the sixth year the Two-Zhe transport vice commissioner Liu Minshi and the Zhexi intendant Rui Hui were ordered to build a gate-weir at Xinjing Pond against the sea tide;

sentences.zh: 楊家港東開河置閘，通行鹽船。

translations.literal: east of Yangjia Harbor a river was opened and a gate set up to allow salt boats to pass.
translations.idiomatic: east of Yangjia Harbor a channel was opened and a gate installed for salt boats.

sentences.zh: 仍差閘官一人，兵級十五人，以時啟閉挑撩。

translations.literal: A gate officer and fifteen soldier ranks were also assigned to open, close, and dredge in season.
translations.idiomatic: One gate officer and fifteen soldiers were assigned to open, close, and dredge the works on schedule.

sentences.zh: 五月，又以兩折轉運司並常州守臣言，填築五瀉上、下兩閘，及修築閘裏堤岸。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the words of the Two-Zhe transport commission and Changzhou's prefectural chief together, the upper and lower gates of Wuxie were filled and built up, and the dikes and banks inside the gates were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on petition from the Two-Zhe transport office and the prefect of Changzhou, the upper and lower Wuxie gates were rebuilt and the embankments within them repaired.

sentences.zh: 仍于郭瀆港口舜郎廟側水聚會處，築捺硬壩，以防走泄運水。

translations.literal: At Guodu Harbor mouth beside Shunlang Temple where waters meet, a pressed hard dam was also built to prevent run-off of transport canal water.
translations.idiomatic: At Guodu Harbor beside Shunlang Temple, where the waters meet, a hard-packed dam was also built to keep canal water from escaping.

sentences.zh: 委無錫知縣主掌鑰匣，遇水深六尺，方許開閘，通放客舟。

translations.literal: The Wuxi magistrate was entrusted to hold the key-casket; only when the water reached six chi in depth was opening the gate permitted to release passenger boats.
translations.idiomatic: The magistrate of Wuxi was charged with the keys; the gate was to open for passenger boats only when the water stood six chi deep.

sentences.zh: 淳熙五年，以漕臣陳峴言，於十月募工開浚無錫縣以西橫林、小井及奔牛、呂城一帶地高水淺之處，以通漕舟。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chunxi, on transport commissioner Chen Xian's words, in the tenth month labor was recruited to dredge west of Wuxi county at Henglin, Xiaojing, and the stretch around Benniu and Lücheng where the terrain is high and water shallow, so that transport boats might pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Chunxi, on the report of Transport Commissioner Chen Xian, labor was hired in the tenth month to dredge west of Wuxi at Henglin, Xiaojing, Benniu, and Lücheng where the bed runs high and shallow, so grain boats could pass.

sentences.zh: 九年，知常州章沖奏：

translations.literal: In the ninth year, the prefect of Changzhou Zhang Chong memorialized:
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Zhang Chong, prefect of Changzhou, memorialized:

sentences.zh: 常州東北曰深港、利港、黃田港、夏港、五鬥港，其西曰灶子港、孟瀆、泰伯瀆、烈塘，江陰之東曰趙港、白沙港、石頭港、陳港、蔡港、私港、令節港，皆古人開導以為溉田無窮之利者也；

translations.literal: Northeast of Changzhou are Shen Harbor, Li Harbor, Huangtian Harbor, Xia Harbor, and Wudou Harbor; west are Zaozi Harbor, Mengdu, Taibo Creek, and Lietang; east of Jiangyin are Zhao Harbor, Baisha Harbor, Shitou Harbor, Chen Harbor, Cai Harbor, S Harbor, and Lingjie Harbor—all opened by the ancients for the boundless benefit of irrigating fields;
translations.idiomatic: Northeast of Changzhou lie Shen Harbor, Li Harbor, Huangtian Harbor, Xia Harbor, and Wudou Harbor; to the west are Zaozi Harbor, Mengdu, Taibo Creek, and Lietang; east of Jiangyin are Zhao Harbor, Baisha Harbor, Shitou Harbor, Chen Harbor, Cai Harbor, Si Harbor, and Lingjie Harbor—all ancient channels opened for the endless benefit of irrigation;

sentences.zh: 今所在堙塞，不能灌溉。

translations.literal: Now wherever they are they are blocked and cannot irrigate.
translations.idiomatic: Today they are choked everywhere and can no longer irrigate.

sentences.zh: 臣嘗講求其說，抑欲不勞民，不費財，而漕渠旱不幹，水不溢，用力省而見功速，可以為悠久之利者，在州之西南曰白鶴溪，自金壇縣洮湖而下，今淺狹特七十餘里，若用工浚治，則漕渠一帶，無乾涸之患；

translations.literal: Your subject has once investigated this doctrine, wishing not to weary the people or waste funds, yet that the transport canal in drought not dry and in flood not overflow, with effort saved and results seen quickly, for lasting benefit: southwest of the prefecture is Baihe Stream, from Jintan county's Tao Lake downstream; now it is shallow and narrow for more than seventy li alone—if labor dredges it, the whole transport canal stretch will have no drought and drying affliction;
translations.idiomatic: I have studied how to spare the people expense yet keep the canal from drying in drought or overflowing in flood, with little labor and quick results for lasting benefit: southwest of the prefecture lies Baihe Stream, flowing from Tao Lake in Jintan—now shallow and narrow for more than seventy li; if dredged, the canal stretch will be spared drought;

sentences.zh: 其南曰西蠡河，自宜興太湖而下，止開浚二十餘里，若更令深遠，則太湖水來，漕渠一百七十餘里，可免浚治之擾。

translations.literal: South of it is Xili River, from Yixing's Tai Lake downstream; only a little more than twenty li have been opened and dredged—if it were made deeper and farther, then Tai Lake water would come and the transport canal's more than one hundred seventy li could be spared the trouble of dredging.
translations.idiomatic: South lies Xili River from Tai Lake at Yixing—only twenty-odd li have been dredged; if deepened further, Tai Lake water would feed one hundred seventy li of canal and spare repeated dredging.

sentences.zh: 至若望亭堰閘，置於唐之至德，而徹於本朝之嘉祐，至元祐七年復置，未幾又毀之。

translations.literal: As for Wangting weir-gate, it was set up in Tang's Zhide era, abolished in our dynasty's Jiayou, restored in the seventh year of Yuanyou, and shortly after destroyed again.
translations.idiomatic: As for the Wangting weir-gate, built in the Zhide era of Tang, removed in Jiayou of our dynasty, restored in the seventh year of Yuanyou, and soon destroyed again.

sentences.zh: 臣謂設此堰閘，有三利焉：陽羨諸瀆之水奔趨而下，有以節之，則當潦歲，平江三邑必無下流淫溢之患，一也。

translations.literal: Your subject holds that setting up this weir-gate has three benefits: the waters of Yangxian's various creeks rush downward—having means to regulate them, then in flood years the three districts of Pingjiang will certainly have no downstream excessive overflow affliction; that is the first.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that restoring this weir-gate brings three benefits: first, the creeks of Yangxian rush down unchecked—regulated here, the three districts of Pingjiang will be spared downstream flooding in wet years.

sentences.zh: 自常州至望亭一百三十五里，運河一有所節，則沿河之田，旱歲資以灌溉，二也。

translations.literal: From Changzhou to Wangting is one hundred thirty-five li; once the transport canal has regulation, the fields along the river in drought years may rely on it for irrigation—that is the second.
translations.idiomatic: Second, along the one hundred thirty-five li from Changzhou to Wangting, fields beside the canal could draw irrigation in drought years if the water were held back.

sentences.zh: 每歲冬春之交，重綱及使命往來，多苦淺涸；

translations.literal: Each year at the turn of winter and spring, heavy convoys and mission traffic coming and going often suffer shallow and dry conditions;
translations.idiomatic: Third, each winter and spring heavy convoys and official missions suffer from shallow water;

sentences.zh: 今啟閉以時，足通舟楫，後免車畝灌注之勞，三也。

translations.literal: now opening and closing in season would suffice for boats to pass, and later spare the labor of cart-hauling and scooping to pour water—that is the third.
translations.idiomatic: timely opening and closing would float the boats and spare the labor of hauling water by cart and scoop.

sentences.zh: 詔令相度開浚。

translations.literal: An edict ordered a survey and dredging.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered a survey and dredging.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰元年，守臣李玨言：

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiatai, the prefectural chief Li Jue said:
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiatai Prefect Li Jue reported:

sentences.zh: 州境北邊揚子大江，南並太湖，東連震澤，西據滆湖，而漕渠，界乎其間。

translations.literal: Within the prefecture's borders, on the north is the Yangzi great river, on the south adjoins Tai Lake, on the east connects to Lake Zhen, on the west occupies Ge Lake, and the transport canal lies between them.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture borders the Yangtze on the north, Tai Lake on the south, Lake Zhen on the east, and Ge Lake on the west, with the grain canal running between.

sentences.zh: 漕渠兩傍曰白鶴溪、西蠡河、南戚氏、北戚氏、直湖州港，通於二湖；

translations.literal: On both sides of the transport canal are Baihe Stream, Xili River, South Qishi, North Qishi, and Zhihuzhou Harbor, connecting to the two lakes;
translations.idiomatic: Beside the canal lie Baihe Stream, Xili River, South Qishi, North Qishi, and Zhihuzhou Harbor, linking the two lakes;

sentences.zh: 曰利浦、孟瀆、烈塘、橫河、五瀉諸港，通于大江，而中間又各自為支溝斷汊，曲繞參錯，不以數計。

translations.literal: and Li Pu, Mengdu, Lietang, Heng River, Wuxie, and the various harbors connect to the great river; between them are also branch ditches and cut-off channels winding and crossing in confusion, beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: and Li Pu, Mengdu, Lietang, Heng River, Wuxie, and other harbors reach the Yangtze, while between them branch channels and cut-offs wind and cross beyond number.

sentences.zh: 水利之源，多於他郡，而常苦易旱之患，何哉？

translations.literal: Sources of water benefit are more numerous than in other prefectures, yet it constantly suffers the affliction of easy drought—why?
translations.idiomatic: Water sources here exceed those of other prefectures, yet drought afflicts it constantly—why?

sentences.zh: 臣嘗詢訪其故：漕渠東起望亭，西上呂城，一百八十餘里，形勢西高東下。

translations.literal: Your subject has inquired into the reason: the transport canal begins in the east at Wangting and runs west up to Lücheng, more than one hundred eighty li, its terrain high in the west and descending eastward.
translations.idiomatic: I have inquired into the cause: the canal runs more than one hundred eighty li from Wangting in the east to Lücheng in the west, sloping down from west to east.

sentences.zh: 加以歲久淺淤，自河岸至底，其深不滿四五尺。

translations.literal: Moreover, as years have lengthened it has grown shallow and silted; from the river bank to the bottom the depth is less than four or five chi.
translations.idiomatic: Years of silting have left it shallow—from bank to bottom scarcely four or five chi deep.

sentences.zh: 常年春雨連綿、江湖泛漲之時，河流忽盈驟減；

translations.literal: In normal years when spring rain is continuous and rivers and lakes flood and rise, the river channel suddenly fills and swiftly diminishes;
translations.idiomatic: In normal years, when spring rains fall and the rivers and lakes rise, the channel fills suddenly and drains away just as fast;

sentences.zh: 連歲雨澤愆闕，江湖退縮，渠形尤亢；

translations.literal: in successive years when rain and moisture are deficient, rivers and lakes recede, and the channel's form is especially elevated;
translations.idiomatic: in years of drought, when the rivers and lakes fall, the channel bed stands especially high;

sentences.zh: 間雖得雨，水無所受，旋即走泄，南入於湖，北歸大江，東徑注於吳江；

translations.literal: even when rain is occasionally obtained, the water has nothing to receive it and at once runs off—south into the lakes, north back to the great river, east directly pouring into Wujiang;
translations.idiomatic: even when rain falls, nothing holds the water; it runs off at once south into the lakes, north to the Yangtze, and east straight into Wujiang;

sentences.zh: 晴未旬日，又復乾涸，此其易旱一也。

translations.literal: within ten days of clear weather it is dry again—this is the first reason for easy drought.
translations.idiomatic: within ten clear days it is dry again—this is the first cause of drought.

sentences.zh: 至若兩傍諸港，如白鶴溪、西蠡河、直湖、烈塘、五瀉堰，日為沙土淤漲，遇潮高水泛之時，尚可通行舟楫；

translations.literal: As for the various harbors on both sides, such as Baihe Stream, Xili River, Zhihu, Lietang, and Wuxie Weir, daily sand and soil silt and rise; when tides are high and waters flood they can still admit boats;
translations.idiomatic: As for the harbors on either side—Baihe Stream, Xili River, Zhihu, Lietang, and Wuxie Weir—daily silting chokes them; only at high tide can boats pass;

sentences.zh: 若值小汐久晴，則俱不能通。

translations.literal: if a small ebb tide and prolonged clear weather are met, none can be traversed.
translations.idiomatic: at low tide after prolonged fair weather, none of them can be used.

sentences.zh: 應自余支溝別港，皆已堙塞，故雖有江湖之浸，不見其利，此其易旱二也。

translations.literal: Presumably from the remaining branch ditches and separate harbors, all are already blocked and silted; therefore though there is soaking from rivers and lakes, its benefit is not seen—this is the second reason for easy drought.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile the branch channels and lesser harbors are all choked, so though rivers and lakes surround the prefecture, their benefit is lost—this is the second cause of drought.

sentences.zh: 況漕渠一帶，綱運於是經由，使客於此往返。

translations.literal: Moreover along the transport canal, grain convoys pass through here, and envoys and travelers go back and forth.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the transport canal carries grain convoys through this region, and envoys and travelers pass back and forth along it.

sentences.zh: 每遇水澀，綱運便阻；

translations.literal: Whenever the water runs shallow, grain transport is blocked;
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the water runs shallow, grain transport is blocked;

sentences.zh: 一入冬月，津送使客，作壩車水，科役百姓，不堪其擾；

translations.literal: Once winter arrives, ferrying and escorting envoys and guests requires building dams and wheeling water, levying corvée on the common people—the suffering is unbearable;
translations.idiomatic: Once winter comes, ferrying and escorting envoys and guests requires building dams and operating water wheels, with corvée levied on the common people until they cannot bear the harassment;

sentences.zh: 豈特溉田缺事而已。

translations.literal: How could this be merely a matter of deficient irrigation for fields alone.
translations.idiomatic: This harm is far more than deficient field irrigation alone.

sentences.zh: 望委轉運、提舉常平官同本州相視漕渠，並徹江湖之處，如法浚治，盡還昔人遺跡，及於望亭修建上、下二閘，固護水源。

translations.literal: I hope the transport commissioner and the intendant for ever-normal granaries may jointly be ordered with this prefecture to inspect the transport canal and places where it reaches lakes and rivers, dredge according to regulation, fully restore the traces left by former men, and at Wangting build upper and lower sluices to secure the water source.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the transport commissioner and the intendant for ever-normal granaries be ordered to inspect the transport canal together with this prefecture, including where it reaches lakes and rivers, dredge it according to regulation, fully restore what former generations left, and at Wangting build upper and lower sluices to secure the water source.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the request.

sentences.zh: 升州水

translations.literal: Waters of Sheng Prefecture
translations.idiomatic: Waters of Sheng Prefecture

sentences.zh: 升州水：乾道五年，建康守臣張孝祥言：「秦淮之水流入府城，別為兩派：正河自鎮淮新橋直注大江；

translations.literal: Waters of Sheng Prefecture: In the fifth year of Qiandao, Jianye defender Zhang Xiaoxiang said: "The waters of the Qinhuai enter the prefectural city and divide into two branches: the main channel from the new Zhenhuai Bridge runs straight into the great river;
translations.idiomatic: Waters of Sheng Prefecture: In the fifth year of Qiandao, Zhang Xiaoxiang, defender of Jianye, reported: "The Qinhuai enters the prefectural city and divides into two branches: the main channel from the new Zhenhuai Bridge runs straight into the great river;

sentences.zh: 其為青溪，自天津橋出柵砦門，亦入于江。

translations.literal: The other is the Qingxi, which leaves through the Zhazhai Gate at Tianjin Bridge and also enters the river.
translations.idiomatic: The other is the Qing Stream, which leaves through the Zhazhai Gate at Tianjin Bridge and also enters the river.

sentences.zh: 緣柵砦門地，近為有力者所得，遂築斷青溪水口，創為花圃。

translations.literal: The land near Zhazhai Gate was lately taken by men of power; they dammed the Qingxi mouth and created a flower garden.
translations.idiomatic: Land near the Zhazhai Gate was lately seized by men of power, who dammed the Qing Stream mouth and made a flower garden.

sentences.zh: 每水流暴至，則泛溢浸蕩，城內居民，尤被其害。

translations.literal: Whenever floodwaters surged violently, overflow flooded and washed—the residents within the city suffered the harm above all.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever floodwaters surged, overflow spread and washed the city; residents within the walls suffered above all.

sentences.zh: 若訪古而求，使青溪直達大江，則建康永無水患矣。」

translations.literal: If one seeks antiquity and restores the Qingxi to run straight to the great river, Jianye would never again know flood calamity."
translations.idiomatic: If one follows antiquity and restores the Qing Stream to reach the great river directly, Jianye would be free of flood calamity forever."

sentences.zh: 既而汪澈奏於西園依異時河道開浚，使水通柵門入。

translations.literal: Later Wang Che memorialized that the Western Garden should be excavated along the former channel so water could enter through the barrier gate.
translations.idiomatic: Later Wang Che memorialized that the Western Garden should be excavated along the former channel so water could pass through the barrier gate.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the request.

sentences.zh: 先是，孝祥又言：「秦淮水三源，一自華山由句容，一自廬山由溧水，一自溧水由赤山湖，至府城東南，合而為一，縈回綿亙三百餘里，溪、港、溝、澮之水盡歸焉。

translations.literal: Earlier Xiaoxiang had also said: "The Qinhuai has three sources—one from Mount Hua through Jurong, one from Mount Lu through Lishui, one from Lishui through Chishan Lake; reaching the southeast of the prefectural city they merge into one, winding and extending more than three hundred li, and the waters of streams, harbors, ditches, and channels all return to it.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Xiaoxiang had also reported: "The Qinhuai has three sources—one from Mount Hua through Jurong, one from Mount Lu through Lishui, one from Lishui through Chishan Lake. At the southeast of the prefectural city they merge into one channel winding more than three hundred li; the waters of streams, harbors, ditches, and canals all drain into it.

sentences.zh: 流上水門，由府城入大江。

translations.literal: Flowing through the upper water gate, they enter the great river from the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: It passes the upper water gate and enters the great river from the prefectural city.

sentences.zh: 舊上、下水門展闊，自兵變後，砌疊稍狹，雖便於一時防守，實遏水源，流通不快。

translations.literal: Formerly the upper and lower water gates were broadened; after the military upheaval they were built up narrower—though convenient for momentary defense, they actually obstruct the water source and flow is not swift.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the upper and lower water gates were widened; after the military upheaval they were built up narrower. Though convenient for momentary defense, they actually choke the source and slow the flow.

sentences.zh: 兼兩岸居民填築河岸，添造屋宇。

translations.literal: Moreover residents on both banks filled in the river banks and added houses.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, residents on both banks filled in the riverbanks and added houses.

sentences.zh: 若禁民不許侵佔，秦淮既復故道，則水不泛溢矣。

translations.literal: If the people are forbidden to encroach, and the Qinhuai recovers its old course, water will not overflow.
translations.idiomatic: If encroachment is forbidden and the Qinhuai recovers its old course, the waters will not overflow.

sentences.zh: 又府東門號陳二渡，有順聖河，正分秦淮之水，每遇春夏天雨連綿，上源奔湧，則分一派之水，自南門外直入于江，故秦淮無氾濫之患。

translations.literal: Again, the prefecture's east gate called Chen'er Ford has the Shunsheng River, which properly divides Qinhuai water; whenever spring and summer bring continuous rain and the upper reaches surge, one branch of water enters the river straight from outside the south gate, so the Qinhuai knows no flooding calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Again, the prefecture's east gate, called Chen'er Ford, has the Shunsheng River, which properly divides Qinhuai water. Whenever spring and summer rains are continuous and the upper reaches surge, one branch enters the river straight from outside the south gate, so the Qinhuai does not flood.

sentences.zh: 今一半淤塞為田，水流不通，若不惜數畝之田，疏導之以復古跡，則其利尤倍。」

translations.literal: Now half is silted into fields and water cannot pass; if one does not spare several mu of fields to dredge and restore the ancient trace, the benefit would be doubled.
translations.idiomatic: Now half is silted into fields and water cannot pass. If several mu of fields are not spared to dredge and restore the ancient course, the benefit would be doubled."

sentences.zh: 其後汪澈言：「水潦之害，大抵緣建康地勢稍低，秦淮既泛，又大江湍漲，其勢湓溢，非由水門窄狹、居民侵築所致。

translations.literal: Later Wang Che said: "Flood calamity comes largely because Jianye's terrain is somewhat low; when the Qinhuai floods and the great river too runs turbulent and swollen, the momentum surges over—not because the water gates are narrow or residents built out on the banks.
translations.idiomatic: Later Wang Che said: "Flooding comes largely because Jianye's terrain is somewhat low. When the Qinhuai floods and the great river too runs turbulent and swollen, the momentum surges over—not because the water gates are narrow or residents have built out on the banks.

sentences.zh: 且上水門砌疊處正不可闊，闊則春水入城益多。

translations.literal: Moreover the upper water gate's built-up section truly cannot be widened—widened, spring water entering the city would increase yet more.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the upper water gate's built-up section truly cannot be widened; widened, spring floodwaters entering the city would increase yet more.

sentences.zh: 自今指定上、下水門砌疊處不動，夾河居民之屋亦不毀除，止去兩岸積壞，使河流通快。

translations.literal: From now designate the upper and lower water gate built sections unmoved, and the houses of residents along the river likewise not destroyed—only remove accumulated ruin on both banks so the river flows swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: From now on designate the upper and lower water-gate built sections unmoved, and likewise do not destroy houses of riverside residents—only remove accumulated ruin on both banks so the river flows swiftly.

sentences.zh: 況城中系行宮東南王方，不宜開鑿。」

translations.literal: Moreover within the city lies the traveling palace's southeastern precinct—excavation should not be opened."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, within the city lies the traveling palace's southeastern precinct—excavation should not be opened."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the request.

sentences.zh: 嘉定五年，守臣黃度言：「府境北據大江，是為天險。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Jiading, defender Huang Du said: "Our prefecture borders the great river to the north—this is heaven's strategic barrier.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Jiading, Huang Du, defender of the prefecture, reported: "Our prefecture borders the great river to the north—this is heaven's strategic barrier.

sentences.zh: 上自採石，下達瓜步，千有餘里，共置六渡：一曰烈山渡，籍于常平司，歲有河渡錢額；

translations.literal: From Caishi above to Guabu below, more than a thousand li, six fords are established in all: first Lieshan Ford, registered with the Ever-Normal Office, with an annual river-ferry revenue quota;
translations.idiomatic: From Caishi upstream to Guabu downstream, more than a thousand li, six fords are established in all. The first is Lieshan Ford, registered with the Ever-Normal Office, with an annual river-ferry revenue quota;

sentences.zh: 五曰南浦渡、龍灣渡、東陽渡、大城堽渡、岡沙渡，籍于府司，亦有河渡錢額。

translations.literal: Five: Nanpu, Longwan, Dongyang, Dacheng'gang, and Gangsha fords, registered with the prefectural office, also with river-ferry revenue quotas.
translations.idiomatic: The other five—Nanpu, Longwan, Dongyang, Dacheng'gang, and Gangsha fords—are registered with the prefectural office and likewise have river-ferry revenue quotas.

sentences.zh: 六渡歲為錢萬餘緡。

translations.literal: The six fords yield more than ten thousand cash annually.
translations.idiomatic: The six fords together yield more than ten thousand strings of cash annually.

sentences.zh: 歷時最久，舟楫廢壞，官吏、篙工，初無廩給，民始病濟，而官漫不省。

translations.literal: Over the longest time boats and oars fell into ruin; clerks and boatmen at first had no grain rations—the people first suffered in crossing while officials never paid heed.
translations.idiomatic: Over the longest time boats fell into ruin; clerks and boatmen at first had no grain rations. The people first suffered in crossing while officials paid no heed.

sentences.zh: 遂至奸豪冒法，別置私渡，左右旁午。

translations.literal: Eventually powerful ruffians broke the law and set up private ferries crowding on left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Eventually powerful ruffians broke the law and set up private ferries crowding on every side.

sentences.zh: 由是官渡濟者絕少，乃聽吏卒苛取以充課。

translations.literal: Because of this official-ferry crossers were exceedingly few, and clerks and soldiers were allowed to exact harshly to meet quotas.
translations.idiomatic: Because of this official-ferry traffic was exceedingly light, and clerks and soldiers were allowed to exact harshly to meet their quotas.

sentences.zh: 徒手者猶憚往來，而車簷牛馬幾不敢行，甚者扼之中流，以邀索錢物。

translations.literal: Even those on foot still feared coming and going, while carts, sedan chairs, oxen, and horses scarcely dared travel; the worst seized people midstream to extort money and goods.
translations.idiomatic: Even those on foot still feared to come and go, while carts, sedan chairs, oxen, and horses scarcely dared cross. The worst seized travelers midstream to extort money and goods.

sentences.zh: 竊以為南北津渡，務在利涉，不容簡忽而但求征課。

translations.literal: I hold that north-south ferries must profit safe crossing and cannot be treated lightly while only seeking tax revenue.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that north-south ferries must serve safe crossing and cannot be neglected while only seeking tax revenue.

sentences.zh: 臣已為之繕治舟艦，選募篙梢，使遠處巡檢兼監渡官。

translations.literal: I have already repaired boats, selected boatmen, and had remote patrol inspectors also serve as ferry overseers.
translations.idiomatic: I have already repaired the boats, selected boatmen, and assigned remote patrol inspectors to serve concurrently as ferry overseers.

sentences.zh: 于諸渡月解錢則例，量江面闊狹，計物貨重輕，斟酌裁減，率三之一或四之一；

translations.literal: Regarding monthly quota payments from the fords—measuring river breadth and goods' weight, I have reduced by deliberation roughly one-third or one-fourth;
translations.idiomatic: Regarding the monthly quota payments from the fords, measuring river breadth and the weight of goods, I have reduced them by deliberation to roughly one-third or one-fourth;

sentences.zh: 自人車牛馬，皆有定數，雕榜約束，不得過收邀阻。

translations.literal: For persons, carts, oxen, and horses there are fixed rates, carved on placards as restrictions, forbidding excess collection and blocking.
translations.idiomatic: for persons, carts, oxen, and horses there are fixed rates, carved on placards as restrictions, forbidding excess collection and obstruction.

sentences.zh: 乞覓裒一歲之入，除烈山渡常平錢如額解送，其餘諸渡，以二分充修船之費，而以其餘給官吏、篙梢、水手食錢。

translations.literal: I beg to gather one year's revenue; except Lieshan Ford's Ever-Normal quota sent as required, for the rest use two-tenths for boat repairs and the remainder for grain money for clerks, boatmen, and sailors.
translations.idiomatic: I beg to gather one year's revenue: except Lieshan Ford's Ever-Normal quota, which should be forwarded as required, for the rest use two-tenths for boat repairs and the remainder for grain money for clerks, boatmen, and sailors.

sentences.zh: 令監渡官逐月照數支散，有餘則解送府司，然後盡絕私渡，不使奸民逾禁。」

translations.literal: Let ferry overseers disburse monthly by the tally; surplus goes to the prefectural office—then private ferries may be utterly cut off so wicked men cannot overstep prohibition."
translations.idiomatic: Let ferry overseers disburse monthly by the tally; surplus goes to the prefectural office. Then private ferries may be utterly abolished so wicked men cannot overstep the prohibition."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the request.

sentences.zh: 秀州水

translations.literal: Waters of Xiu Prefecture
translations.idiomatic: Waters of Xiu Prefecture

sentences.zh: 秀州水：秀州境內有四湖：一曰柘湖，二曰澱山湖，三曰當湖，四曰陳湖。

translations.literal: Waters of Xiu Prefecture: Within the prefecture are four lakes: first Zhe Lake, second Dianshan Lake, third Dang Lake, fourth Chen Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Waters of Xiu Prefecture: Within the prefecture are four lakes: Zhe Lake, Dianshan Lake, Dang Lake, and Chen Lake.

sentences.zh: 東南則柘湖，自金山浦、小官浦入於海。

translations.literal: To the southeast Zhe Lake enters the sea through Jinshan and Xiaoguan harbors.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast, Zhe Lake enters the sea through Jinshan Harbor and Xiaoguan Harbor.

sentences.zh: 西南則澱山湖，自蘆曆浦入於海。

translations.literal: To the southwest Dianshan Lake enters the sea through Luli Harbor.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest, Dianshan Lake enters the sea through Luli Harbor.

sentences.zh: 西北則陳湖，自大姚港、朱裏浦入于吳松江。

translations.literal: To the northwest Chen Lake enters Wusong River through Dayao and Zhuli harbors.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest, Chen Lake enters the Wusong River through Dayao Harbor and Zhuli Harbor.

sentences.zh: 其南則當湖，自月河、南浦口、澉浦口亦達於海。

translations.literal: To the south Dang Lake likewise reaches the sea through Moon River, Nanpu Mouth, and Gan Harbor Mouth.
translations.idiomatic: To the south, Dang Lake likewise reaches the sea through Moon River, Nanpu Mouth, and Gan Harbor Mouth.

sentences.zh: 支港相貫。

translations.literal: Branch harbors connect through.
translations.idiomatic: Branch harbors connect through one another.

sentences.zh: 乾道二年，守臣孫大雅奏請，于諸港浦分作閘或斗門，及張涇堰兩岸創築月河，置一閘，其兩柱金口基址，並以石為之，啟閉以時，民賴其利。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qiandao, defender Sun Daya memorialized requesting at various harbor mouths to build sluices or flash gates, and at Zhangjing Weir on both banks create a moon channel and place one sluice—with stone for the two pillar golden mouths and foundations, opening and closing in season—the people relied on the benefit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qiandao, Defender Sun Daya memorialized requesting sluices or flash gates at various harbor mouths, and at Zhangjing Weir on both banks a moon channel with one sluice—the two pillar golden mouths and foundations all in stone, opened and closed in season—on which the people relied for benefit.

sentences.zh: 十三年，兩浙轉運副使張叔獻言：「華亭東南枕海，西連太湖，北接松江，江北復控大海。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Liang-Zhe transport vice commissioner Zhang Shuxian said: "Huating in the southeast abuts the sea, west joins Taihu, north meets Songjiang, and north of the river again controls the great sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Zhang Shuxian, vice transport commissioner for the Two Zhe circuit, reported: "Huating in the southeast abuts the sea, west joins Lake Tai, north meets Songjiang, and north of the river again commands the great sea.

sentences.zh: 地形東南最高，西北稍下。

translations.literal: Terrain is highest in the southeast and somewhat lower northwest.
translations.idiomatic: The terrain is highest in the southeast and somewhat lower in the northwest.

sentences.zh: 柘湖十有八港，正在其南，故古來築堰以禦鹹潮。

translations.literal: Zhe Lake has eighteen harbors lying just to its south—since antiquity weirs were built to repel salt tide.
translations.idiomatic: Zhe Lake has eighteen harbors lying just to its south; since antiquity weirs were built there to repel the salt tide.

sentences.zh: 元祐中，於新涇塘置閘，後因沙淤廢毀。

translations.literal: In Yuanyou, at Xinjing embankment a sluice was placed; later sand silted and it was ruined.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanyou era a sluice was placed at Xinjing embankment; later sand silted it shut and it was ruined.

sentences.zh: 今除十五處築堰及置石鹈達外，獨有新涇塘、招賢港、徐浦塘三處，見有鹹潮奔沖，渰塞民田。

translations.literal: Now besides fifteen places with weirs built and stone pelican sluices installed, only Xinjing embankment, Zhaoxian Harbor, and Xupu embankment still suffer salt tide rushing in and flooding fields.
translations.idiomatic: Now besides fifteen places where weirs were built and stone pelican sluices installed, only Xinjing embankment, Zhaoxian Harbor, and Xupu embankment still suffer salt tide rushing in and flooding the people's fields.

sentences.zh: 今依新涇塘置閘一所，又於兩旁貼築鹹塘，以防海潮透入民田。

translations.literal: Now according to Xinjing embankment build one sluice, and on both sides attach salt embankments to guard against sea tide penetrating into people's fields.
translations.idiomatic: Now, following the model of Xinjing embankment, build one sluice, and on both sides attach salt embankments to keep the sea tide from penetrating into the people's fields.

sentences.zh: 其相近徐浦塘，元系小派，自合築堰。

translations.literal: Nearby Xupu embankment was originally a small branch and ought to have a weir built.
translations.idiomatic: Nearby Xupu embankment was originally a small branch and ought to have a weir built as well.

sentences.zh: 又欲於招賢港更置一石鹈達。

translations.literal: Also wish to place another stone pelican sluice at Zhaoxian Harbor.
translations.idiomatic: I also wish to place another stone pelican sluice at Zhaoxian Harbor.

sentences.zh: 兼楊湖歲久，今稍淺澱，自當開浚。」

translations.literal: Moreover Yang Lake after long years is somewhat shallow and silted—dredging is appropriate."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Yang Lake, after many years, has grown somewhat shallow and silted and should be dredged."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「此閘須當為之。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "This sluice truly must be built.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "This sluice truly must be built.

sentences.zh: 方今邊事寧息，惟當以民事為急。

translations.literal: Now border affairs are peaceful—only people's affairs should be urgent.
translations.idiomatic: Now that border affairs are peaceful, only the people's affairs should be urgent.

sentences.zh: 民事以農為重，朕觀漢文帝詔書，多為農而下。

translations.literal: People's affairs take farming as weighty; I observe Emperor Wen of Han's edicts—many defer to agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: Among the people's affairs, farming is foremost. I observe that Emperor Wen of Han's edicts often defer to agriculture.

sentences.zh: 今置閘，其利久遠，不可憚一時之勞。」

translations.literal: Now building the sluice, the benefit is long-term—one must not fear a moment's labor."
translations.idiomatic: Building this sluice now will bring lasting benefit—one must not shrink from a moment's labor."

sentences.zh: 十五年，以兩浙路轉運判官吳坰奏請，命浙西常平司措置錢谷，勸諭人戶，于農隙並力開浚華亭等處沿海三十六浦堙塞，決泄水勢，為永久利。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, on memorial of Wu Qi, transport judge of the Two Zhe circuit, the Zhexi Ever-Normal Office was ordered to arrange funds, exhort households, and in agricultural slack jointly dredge thirty-six coastal harbors blocked at Huating and elsewhere, releasing water momentum for lasting benefit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, on the memorial of Wu Qi, transport judge of the Two Zhe circuit, the Zhexi Ever-Normal Office was ordered to arrange funds and exhort households to dredge jointly in agricultural slack the thirty-six coastal harbors silted shut at Huating and elsewhere, releasing the water's force for lasting benefit.

sentences.zh: 乾道七年，秀州守臣丘崈奏：「華亭縣東南大海，古有十八堰，捍禦鹹潮。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Qiandao, Xiu defender Qiu Kai memorialized: "Huating County southeast faces the great sea; anciently there were eighteen weirs repelling salt tide.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Qiandao, Qiu Kai, defender of Xiu, memorialized: "Huating County in the southeast faces the great sea. Anciently there were eighteen weirs holding back the salt tide.

sentences.zh: 其十七久皆捺斷，不通裏河；

translations.literal: Seventeen long since were dammed shut, not connecting to the inner river;
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen have long since been dammed shut and no longer connect to the inner river;

sentences.zh: 獨有新涇唐一所不曾築捺，海水往來，遂害一縣民田。

translations.literal: Only Xinjing embankment one place was never dammed—sea water came and went and thus harmed the entire county's fields.
translations.idiomatic: only at Xinjing embankment was one place never dammed, so sea water came and went and harmed the entire county's fields.

sentences.zh: 緣新涇舊堰迫近大海，潮勢湍急，其港面闊，難以施工，設或築捺，決不經久。

translations.literal: Because the old weir at Xinjing pressed near the sea, tide momentum is swift, the harbor mouth wide, hard to work on—if dammed it would not endure.
translations.idiomatic: Because the old weir at Xinjing lies close to the sea, the tide runs swift and the harbor mouth is wide, making work difficult; even if dammed, it would not endure.

sentences.zh: 運港在涇塘向裏二十里，比之新涇，水勢稍緩。

translations.literal: Yun Harbor lies twenty li inward from Jing embankment; compared with Xinjing the water momentum is somewhat slower.
translations.idiomatic: Yun Harbor lies twenty li inland from Jing embankment; compared with Xinjing, its water runs somewhat slower.

sentences.zh: 若就此築堰，決可永久，堰外凡管民田，皆無鹹潮之害。

translations.literal: If a weir is built here it can be permanent; beyond the weir all fields governed would be free of salt tide harm.
translations.idiomatic: If a weir is built here it can be permanent, and all fields beyond the weir would be free of salt-tide harm.

sentences.zh: 其運港止可捺堰，不可置閘。

translations.literal: Yun Harbor can only be dammed as weir, cannot have a sluice placed.
translations.idiomatic: At Yun Harbor one can only build a dammed weir; a sluice cannot be placed.

sentences.zh: 不惟瀕海土性虛燥，難以建置；

translations.literal: Not only is coastal soil hollow and dry, hard to build on;
translations.idiomatic: Not only is coastal soil loose and dry, making construction difficult;

sentences.zh: 兼一日兩潮，通放鹽運，不減數十百艘，先後不齊，比至通放盡絕，勢必晝夜啟而不閉，則鹹潮無緣斷絕。

translations.literal: Moreover twice daily tides release salt transport—not fewer than tens or hundreds of boats, coming not in order—by the time passage is finished they would necessarily be opened day and night without closing, and salt tide could not be cut off.
translations.idiomatic: moreover twice daily tides carry salt transport—not fewer than tens or hundreds of boats, arriving out of order. By the time passage is finished the gates would have to stand open day and night, and the salt tide could never be shut out.

sentences.zh: 運港堰外別有港汊大小十六，亦合興修。」

translations.literal: Beyond Yun Harbor weir are sixteen more harbor branches large and small that should also be developed."
translations.idiomatic: Beyond Yun Harbor weir are sixteen more harbor branches, large and small, that should likewise be improved."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the request.

sentences.zh: 八年，崈又言：「興築捍海塘堰，今已畢工，地理闊遠，全藉人力固護。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Kai again said: "The sea-bar embankment weirs are now complete—the terrain is broad and remote and wholly depends on human force to guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Kai again reported: "The sea-barring embankment weirs are now complete. The terrain is broad and remote and wholly depends on human labor to maintain.

sentences.zh: 乞令本縣知、佐兼帶'主管塘堰職事'系銜，秩滿，視有無損壞以為殿最。

translations.literal: I beg to order this county's magistrate and aides to bear the concurrent title 'Supervisor of embankment-weir duties,' and at term's end regard damage or not for merit rating.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that this county's magistrate and aides bear the concurrent title 'Supervisor of Embankment-Weir Duties,' and that at term's end damage or preservation be weighed for their merit rating.

sentences.zh: 仍令巡尉據地分巡察。」

translations.literal: Also order patrol constables to inspect by district."
translations.idiomatic: Also order patrol constables to inspect by district."

sentences.zh: 詔特轉丘崈左承議郎，令所築華亭捍海塘堰，趁時栽種蘆葦，不許樵采。

translations.literal: An edict specially promoted Qiu Kai to Left Gentleman for Managing Affairs, ordered the Huating sea-bar embankment weirs to plant reeds in season, forbidding fuel-cutting.
translations.idiomatic: An edict specially promoted Qiu Kai to Left Gentleman for Managing Affairs and ordered that the Huating sea-barring embankment weirs plant reeds in season, with fuel-cutting forbidden.

sentences.zh: 九年，又命華亭縣作監閘官，招收土軍五十人，巡邏堤堰，專一禁戢，將卑薄處時加修捺。

translations.literal: In the ninth year also ordered Huating to establish supervising sluice officials, recruit fifty local soldiers to patrol dikes, specifically prohibiting, strengthening thin places in season.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the court also ordered Huating to establish supervising sluice officials, recruit fifty local soldiers to patrol the dikes and enforce prohibitions, and strengthen thin places in season.

sentences.zh: 令知縣、縣尉並帶'主管堰事'，則上下協心，不致廢壞。

translations.literal: Order magistrate and county lieutenant also to bear 'Supervisor of weir duties' so above and below cooperate and ruin is not reached.
translations.idiomatic: The magistrate and county lieutenant were also ordered to bear the title 'Supervisor of Weir Duties,' so that above and below would cooperate and prevent ruin.

sentences.zh: 淳熙九年，又命守臣趙善悉發一萬工，修治海鹽縣常豐閘及八十一堰壩，務令高牢，以固護水勢，遇旱可以瀦積。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Chunxi again ordered defender Zhao Shanxi to mobilize ten thousand workers to repair Changfeng sluice and eighty-one weir dams at Haiyan, striving for height and firmness to secure water momentum, storing in drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Chunxi the court again ordered Defender Zhao Shanxi to mobilize ten thousand workers to repair Changfeng sluice and eighty-one weir dams at Haiyan County, striving to make them high and firm to secure the water's force and store water against drought.

sentences.zh: 十年，以浙西提舉司言，命秀州發卒浚治華亭鄉魚祈塘，使接松江太湖之水；

translations.literal: In the tenth year, on the Zhexi intendant's word, ordered Xiu to send troops to dredge Yuji embankment at Huating township connecting Songjiang-Taihu waters;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, on the word of the Zhexi intendant's office, the court ordered Xiu to send troops to dredge Yuji embankment pond in Huating township so it would connect with Songjiang and Lake Tai waters;

sentences.zh: 遇旱，即開西閘堰放水入泖湖，為一縣之利。

translations.literal: In drought open the west sluice weir to release water into Mao Lake—for the whole county's benefit.
translations.idiomatic: in drought, open the west sluice weir to release water into Mao Lake for the benefit of the whole county.

sentences.zh: 蘇州水：乾道初，平江守臣沈度、兩浙漕臣陳彌作言：「疏浚昆山、常熟縣界白茆等十浦，約用三百萬餘工。

translations.literal: Waters of Su Prefecture: At the beginning of Qiandao, Pingjiang defender Shen Du and the Two-Zhe transport commissioner Chen Mizuo jointly reported: "Dredging the ten harbors such as Baimao on the border of Kunshan and Changshu counties will require about three million work-days.
translations.idiomatic: Waters of Su Prefecture: At the beginning of Qiandao, Shen Du, defender of Pingjiang, and Chen Mizuo, transport commissioner for the Two-Zhe circuit, jointly reported: "Dredging the ten harbors such as Baimao on the border of Kunshan and Changshu counties will require about three million work-days.

sentences.zh: 其所開港浦，並通徹大海。

translations.literal: The harbors that are opened all run through to the great sea.
translations.idiomatic: The harbors that are opened all run through to the great sea.

sentences.zh: 遇潮，則海內細沙，隨泛以入；

translations.literal: When the tide comes, fine sand from the sea floats in with it;
translations.idiomatic: When the tide comes, fine sand from the sea floats in with it;

sentences.zh: 潮退，則沙泥沉墜，漸致淤塞。

translations.literal: when the tide falls, sand and mud sink and settle, gradually causing silting.
translations.idiomatic: when the tide falls, sand and mud sink and settle, gradually causing silting.

sentences.zh: 今依舊招置闕額開江兵卒，次第開浚，不數月，諸浦可以漸次通徹。

translations.literal: Now, as before, recruit river-opening soldiers to fill vacant quotas, dredge in sequence, and within a few months the harbors can gradually be opened through.
translations.idiomatic: Now, as before, recruit river-opening soldiers to fill vacant quotas, dredge in sequence, and within a few months the harbors can gradually be opened through.

sentences.zh: 又用兵卒駕船，遇潮退，搖盪隨之，常使沙泥隨潮退落，不致停積，實為久利。」

translations.literal: Also use soldiers to man boats; when the tide falls, rock with it, constantly letting sand and mud fall back with the receding tide so it does not accumulate—this is truly a lasting benefit."
translations.idiomatic: Also use soldiers to man boats; when the tide falls, rock with it, constantly letting sand and mud fall back with the receding tide so it does not accumulate—this is truly a lasting benefit."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年，詔平江府守臣與許浦駐紮戚世明同措置開浚許浦港，三旬訖工。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chunxi, an edict ordered the Pingjiang prefectural defender and Qi Shiming, stationed at Xupu, jointly to arrange dredging of Xupu Harbor; the work was finished in thirty days.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chunxi, an edict ordered the Pingjiang prefectural defender and Qi Shiming, stationed at Xupu, jointly to arrange dredging of Xupu Harbor; the work was finished in thirty days.

sentences.zh: 黃岩縣水：淳熙十二年，浙東提舉勾昌泰言：「黃岩縣舊有官河，自縣前至溫嶺，凡九十里。

translations.literal: Waters of Huangyan County: In the twelfth year of Chunxi, eastern Zhe intendant Gou Changtai said: "Huangyan's old official river from before the county to Wenling—ninety li in all.
translations.idiomatic: Waters of Huangyan County: In the twelfth year of Chunxi, Gou Changtai, intendant for eastern Zhe, reported: "Huangyan's old official river runs from before the county seat to Wenling—ninety li in all.

sentences.zh: 其支流九百三十六處，皆以溉田。

translations.literal: Its branch streams nine hundred thirty-six places—all irrigate fields.
translations.idiomatic: Its branch streams number nine hundred thirty-six, all used to irrigate fields.

sentences.zh: 元有五閘，久廢不修。

translations.literal: Originally there were five sluices, long abandoned unrepaired.
translations.idiomatic: Originally there were five sluices, long abandoned and unrepaired.

sentences.zh: 今欲建一閘，約費二萬餘緡，乞詔兩浙運司于窠名錢內支撥。」

translations.literal: Now wish to build one sluice, costing about twenty thousand-odd cash—I beg an edict for the Two Zhe transport office to disperse from named revenue categories.
translations.idiomatic: Now I wish to build one sluice, costing about twenty thousand-odd strings of cash. I beg an edict that the Two Zhe transport office disburse the sum from its named revenue accounts."

sentences.zh: 明年六月，昌泰復言：「黃岩縣東地名東浦，紹興中開鑿，置常豐閘。

translations.literal: Next year sixth month Changtai again said: "East of Huangyan at Dongpu, excavated in Shaoxing, placed Changfeng sluice.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, in the sixth month, Changtai again reported: "East of Huangyan, at a place called Dongpu, a channel was excavated in the Shaoxing era and Changfeng sluice was placed.

sentences.zh: 名為決水入江，其實縣道欲令舟船取徑通過，每船納錢，以充官費。

translations.literal: Named as releasing water into the river—actually the county wanted boats to take a shortcut through, each boat paying cash to meet official costs.
translations.idiomatic: It was named as releasing water into the river, but in fact the county wanted boats to take a shortcut through it, each boat paying cash to meet official costs.

sentences.zh: 一日兩潮，一潮一淤，才遇旱乾，更無灌溉之備。

translations.literal: Twice daily tides, each tide silts once—when drought came there was no irrigation provision.
translations.idiomatic: Twice daily tides came; each tide silted it once. When drought came, there was no irrigation provision.

sentences.zh: 已將此閘築為平陸，乞戒自今永不得開鑿放入江湖，庶絕後患。」

translations.literal: This sluice has been built flat—beg to admonish never again open and release into rivers and lakes, ending later trouble."
translations.idiomatic: This sluice has now been built level. I beg that hereafter it never again be opened to release water into rivers and lakes, ending later trouble."

sentences.zh: 荊、襄諸水：紹興二十八年，監察御史都民望言：「荊南江陵縣東三十里，沿江北岸古堤一處，地名黃潭。

translations.literal: Waters of Jing and Xiang: In the twenty-eighth year of Shaoxing, censor Du Minwang said: "Thirty li east of Jiangling in Jingnan along the north bank is an old embankment at Huangtan.
translations.idiomatic: Waters of Jing and Xiang: In the twenty-eighth year of Shaoxing, Censor Du Minwang reported: "Thirty li east of Jiangling County in Jingnan, along the north bank of the river, is an old embankment at a place called Huangtan.

sentences.zh: 建炎間，邑官開決，放入江水，設以為險阻以禦盜。

translations.literal: During Jianyan local officials opened it to admit river water, setting it as a barrier against bandits.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jianyan era local officials opened it to admit river water, making it a barrier against bandits.

sentences.zh: 既而夏潦漲溢，荊南、復州千餘里，皆被其害。

translations.literal: Then summer floodwaters swelled and overflow—Jingnan and Fuzhou for more than a thousand li all suffered harm.
translations.idiomatic: Then summer floodwaters swelled and overflowed, and Jingnan and Fuzhou for more than a thousand li all suffered harm.

sentences.zh: 去年因民訴，始塞之。

translations.literal: Last year on people's complaint it was blocked again.
translations.idiomatic: Last year, on the people's complaint, it was blocked again.

sentences.zh: 乞令知縣遇農隙隨力修補，勿致損壞。」

translations.literal: Beg to order the magistrate in agricultural slack to repair according to strength—do not let damage occur."
translations.idiomatic: I beg that the magistrate be ordered, in agricultural slack, to repair it according to his means and not let it fall into ruin."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the request.

sentences.zh: 淳熙八年，襄陽府守臣郭杲言：「本府有木渠，在中廬縣界，擁漹水東流四十五里，入宜城縣。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Chunxi, Xiangyang defender Guo Gao said: "This prefecture has the Wooden Channel in Zhonglu County boundary, blocking shallow water east forty-five li into Yicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Chunxi, Guo Gao, defender of Xiangyang, reported: "This prefecture has the Wooden Channel, on the border of Zhonglu County, holding back shallow water flowing east forty-five li into Yicheng County.

sentences.zh: 後漢南郡太守王寵，嘗鑿之以泄蠻水，謂之木裏溝，可溉田六千餘頃。

translations.literal: Later Han's Nan commandery chief Wang Chong once excavated it to release Mán water, called Wooden Lane Ditch, able to irrigate more than six thousand qing.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chong, chief of Nan commandery in Later Han, once excavated it to release the Mán River's water. It is called the Wooden Lane Ditch and could irrigate more than six thousand qing.

sentences.zh: 歲久堙塞，乞行修治。」

translations.literal: After years it was silted shut—I beg that repair be undertaken."
translations.idiomatic: After years it had silted shut. I beg that it be repaired."

sentences.zh: 既而杲又修護城堤以捍江流，繼築救生堤為二閘，一通于江，一達於濠。
